affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: A global fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) moved roughly 2,000 rows and broke column geometry (Pahang lost 63 rows), so it is applied only at ROW level (2026-11-05): column building keeps the historical tokeniser, and a row whose historical tokens do not fit the columns falls back to the exact ones (one per column, one per money-year column, or amount/share pairs in a `(RM Juta)`/`(%)` matrix).  That cleared every top-contributor JUMLAH defect (Selangor CMD.41.2019 J11 and CMD.50.2021 J13, Negeri Sembilan CMD.37.2018 J4.10); rows that still fit the columns with a value missing are not re-tokenised.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.
